name: SecureWebArena
titleZh: SecureWebArena：面向 LVLM 网页智能体的整体安全评测基准
summary: A holistic security benchmark for vision-language web agents, built on six simulated but realistic web environments to cover attack surfaces narrower benchmarks miss.
summaryZh: 面向视觉语言网页智能体的整体安全基准，基于六个模拟但真实的网页环境，覆盖以往窄口径基准漏掉的攻击面。
keyFact: SecureWebArena (Ying et al., arXiv:2510.10073, first posted 2025-10-11, revised 2026-04-14) presents itself as the first holistic security benchmark for LVLM-based web agents, spanning six simulated web environments rather than the single attack family earlier work covered.
keyFactZh: SecureWebArena（Ying 等，arXiv:2510.10073，2025-10-11 首次提交，2026-04-14 修订）自称是首个面向 LVLM 网页智能体的整体安全基准，覆盖六个模拟网页环境，而此前工作多只盯单一攻击类型。
whyItMatters: Most agent security work tests prompt injection in isolation; this one varies the environment, which is closer to how deployments actually get attacked.
whyItMattersZh: 多数 Agent 安全研究只单独测提示注入；这个基准换的是环境变量，更接近真实部署被攻击的方式。
title: SecureWebArena: A Holistic Security Evaluation Benchmark for LVLM-based Web Agents
